nodes.name: Start Webhook
nodes.notes: Descripción de un proceso: {sop_id, title, owner_email, department?, source_text}. En live la dispara un formulario o una transcripción de llamada. Protegido por x-sop-token.

nodes.name: Normalize Draft
nodes.notes: DETERMINÍSTICO: id seguro, título, correo del responsable, departamento conocido, tamaño del texto. "now" solo en mock con token.

parameters.query:
WITH k AS (SELECT 'sop-draft:' || $1 || ':' || md5($2) AS key),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (key, workflow, execution_id, status)
  SELECT key, 'sop-draft', $3, 'processing' FROM k
  ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE
    SET execution_id = EXCLUDED.execution_id, status = 'processing', claimed_at = now(), finished_at = NULL,
        attempts = idempotency_keys.attempts + 1
    WHERE idempotency_keys.status = 'failed'
       OR (idempotency_keys.status = 'processing' AND idempotency_keys.claimed_at < now() - interval '1 hour')
  RETURNING key
)
SELECT (SELECT key FROM k) AS key, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins) AS is_new

nodes.name: Claim Idempotency
nodes.notes: Reclamo atómico (PRIMARY KEY). Se puede reprocesar si el intento anterior quedó "failed" o "processing" hace más de 1 h.

nodes.name: Prepare Source
nodes.notes: DETERMINÍSTICO: contraseñas, claves de API y tarjetas (Luhn) se tapan antes de que la IA o la base de datos vean el texto. Un texto que da órdenes al sistema nunca llega al modelo.

nodes.name: Skip AI
nodes.notes: Fail-closed: no se llama a la IA con un texto que intenta darle órdenes.

nodes.name: Build Extract Request
nodes.notes: El texto va dentro de <source>: es DATO, nunca instrucciones. Cada paso debe traer la frase textual de la que sale.

nodes.name: Mock Extract
nodes.notes: Sustituto local de Claude: cada frase con un verbo de acción es un paso; "If ..." es una decisión. [[mock:ai_down]] simula la caída del modelo.

nodes.name: Claude Extract
nodes.notes:
CONECTA AQUÍ: credencial "Anthropic API". Contrato SIN verificar (tool record_sop).
Sin retryOnFail propio: los reintentos con backoff exponencial los hace el bucle "Claude Extract · check".

nodes.notes: Log de ejecución (Postgres). Rama lateral.

nodes.name: Parse Extract
nodes.notes: Valida la forma y que cada paso traiga su cita. Si no, falla cerrado.

nodes.name: Ground & Check
nodes.notes: DETERMINÍSTICO: solo se conservan los pasos cuya cita está de verdad en el texto (lo que la IA inventó se descarta y queda registrado). Bloquea si hay muy pocos pasos, demasiados descartados, IA caída o inyección; los huecos (sin responsable, duplicados, decisión sin salida) se declaran en el documento.

parameters.query:
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT max(version) FROM sop_versions WHERE sop_id = $1), 0) + 1 AS next_version,
  (SELECT steps FROM sop_versions WHERE sop_id = $1 AND status = 'published' ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1) AS prev_steps,
  (SELECT current_version FROM sop_docs WHERE sop_id = $1) AS current_version

nodes.name: Load Previous
nodes.notes: Número de la nueva versión y pasos de la versión publicada, para mostrar qué cambia.

nodes.name: Build Version
nodes.notes: DETERMINÍSTICO: el documento sale de una PLANTILLA fija (propósito, pasos numerados con responsable y cita, huecos, procedencia). La versión nueva se compara con la publicada.

parameters.query:
WITH d AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j),
doc AS (INSERT INTO sop_docs (sop_id, title, owner_email, department) SELECT j->>'sop_id', j->>'title', j->>'owner_email', NULLIF(j->>'department', '') FROM d ON CONFLICT (sop_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING sop_id),
v AS (INSERT INTO sop_versions (sop_id, version, status, purpose, steps, gaps, doc_text, source_hash, flags, created_at)
      SELECT j->>'sop_id', (j->>'version')::int, j->>'status', j->>'purpose', j->'steps', j->'gaps', j->>'doc_text', md5(j->>'source_text'), j->'flags', (j->>'now')::timestamptz FROM d RETURNING sop_id, version),
e AS (INSERT INTO sop_events (sop_id, version, event, actor, detail) SELECT sop_id, version, 'drafted', 'system', (SELECT j->'flags' FROM d) FROM v RETURNING id)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM v) AS versions

nodes.name: Persist Version
nodes.notes: Documento, versión y evento de auditoría en UNA sentencia. El texto original no se guarda: solo su md5 y los pasos con su cita.

nodes.name: Send Needs Input
nodes.notes: Mailpit en local. Nada se publica ni se manda a aprobar: el autor recibe el motivo.

nodes.name: Request Approval
nodes.notes: Canal de aprobación: email al responsable del proceso (Mailpit en local). Para Slack, cambiar este nodo por Slack → Send and Wait. Sin respuesta en 48 h no se publica nada.

nodes.name: Apply Human Decision
nodes.notes: Falla cerrado: solo un "sí" explícito publica. Timeout o respuesta ambigua = no se publica.

parameters.query:
WITH d AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j),
cur AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT current_version FROM sop_docs WHERE sop_id = (SELECT j->>'sop_id' FROM d)), 0) AS cv),
pub AS (UPDATE sop_versions v SET status = 'published', approved_by = d.j->>'approved_by', published_at = (d.j->>'now')::timestamptz FROM d
        WHERE v.sop_id = d.j->>'sop_id' AND v.version = (d.j->>'version')::int AND v.status = 'pending_review' AND (SELECT cv FROM cur) <= v.version RETURNING v.sop_id, v.version),
sup AS (UPDATE sop_versions v SET status = 'superseded' FROM d WHERE v.sop_id = d.j->>'sop_id' AND v.status = 'published' AND v.version <> (d.j->>'version')::int AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pub) RETURNING v.version),
doc AS (UPDATE sop_docs s SET current_version = pub.version, status = 'published', published_at = (d.j->>'now')::timestamptz, review_reminded_at = NULL, review_escalated_at = NULL,
          title = d.j->>'title', owner_email = d.j->>'owner_email', department = NULLIF(d.j->>'department', ''), updated_at = now() FROM pub, d WHERE s.sop_id = pub.sop_id RETURNING s.sop_id),
stale AS (UPDATE sop_versions v SET status = 'rejected', flags = v.flags || jsonb_build_object('human', 'stale') FROM d
          WHERE v.sop_id = d.j->>'sop_id' AND v.version = (d.j->>'version')::int AND v.status = 'pending_review' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pub) AND (SELECT cv FROM cur) > v.version RETURNING v.sop_id, v.version),
e AS (INSERT INTO sop_events (sop_id, version, event, actor, detail)
      SELECT sop_id, version, 'published', (SELECT j->>'approved_by' FROM d), jsonb_build_object('superseded', (SELECT count(*) FROM sup)) FROM pub
      UNION ALL SELECT sop_id, version, 'stale_not_published', 'system', '{}'::jsonb FROM stale RETURNING id)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pub) AS published, (SELECT count(*) FROM sup) AS superseded, (SELECT cv FROM cur) AS current_version

nodes.name: Publish Version
nodes.notes: Atómico: publica solo si la versión sigue pendiente y no hay una más nueva ya publicada; la anterior pasa a superseded en la misma sentencia.

nodes.name: Send Published Notice
nodes.notes: Aviso al responsable con el enlace a la página. La versión ya está publicada aunque el aviso falle: el fallo queda visible.

parameters.query:
WITH d AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j),
r AS (UPDATE sop_versions v SET status = 'rejected', flags = v.flags || jsonb_build_object('human', d.j->>'human') FROM d WHERE v.sop_id = d.j->>'sop_id' AND v.version = (d.j->>'version')::int AND v.status = 'pending_review' RETURNING v.sop_id, v.version),
e AS (INSERT INTO sop_events (sop_id, version, event, actor, detail) SELECT sop_id, version, 'rejected', 'owner', jsonb_build_object('human', (SELECT j->>'human' FROM d)) FROM r RETURNING id)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM r) AS rejected

nodes.name: Reject Version
nodes.notes: Rechazada o sin respuesta: la versión queda rechazada y no se publica. Un rechazo por falta de respuesta permite reenviar el mismo texto.

return { json: { ...s, result: { status: 'not_published', sop_id: s.draft.sop_id, version: s.version, retryable: false, errors: ['v' + s.version + ' was approved but NOT published: a newer version (v' + s.publish_info.current_version + ') is already published or this version is no longer pending.'] } } };

parameters.content:
## SOP · Draft, Review & Publish
Code redacts secrets and checks the source, the AI only extracts the steps (each one quoted from the text), code verifies every quote and the quality, a TEMPLATE writes the document, and the process owner approves before anything is published. Versions are atomic: a late approval of an old version never overwrites a newer one.
